reason: A harness plugin that orchestrates a read-only verifier subagent at turn completion and feeds non-pass findings back to the driving agent.

summaries.zh: 在每个顶层回合结束前启动只读验证子代理，并将未通过的缺口反馈给主代理以推动后续处理。
summaries.en: Starts a read-only verifier subagent before each top-level turn closes and feeds non-pass gaps back to the driving agent for follow-up.

capabilities: spawns a read-only verifier subagent before a top-level turn closes
injects verifier gaps into the driving agent
steers follow-up attempts after non-pass verdicts
filters verifier tools using a configurable deny list
